comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C21-C29, C85-C87. Both evaluations find the expression data well-supported by multiple experimental approaches (western blot, RNA-seq, immunofluorescence). Both rate as SUPPORTED with high confidence.
Perfect agreement on claims C48-C53, C55. Both evaluations accept the RNA-seq data demonstrating Xap5l's role as a transcriptional repressor of ciliary genes. Both rate as SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claim C54. Both evaluations accept the Tulp2 KO validation data without challenge. Both rate as SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claims C56-C60. Both evaluations accept the RNA-seq data showing downregulation of ciliary genes in Xap5 cKO, supporting its activator role. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Disagreement on claims C61-C73. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to technical limitations (suboptimal Xap5l antibody, only 2290 peaks, PCR validation needed for Rfx2). Peer review rates as SUPPORTED, with Reviewer 3 accepting CUT&Tag data as strong evidence for direct binding.

Agreement on claims C37-C42 regarding Xap5l KO flagellar defects. Both evaluations accept the comprehensive phenotypic characterization. Both rate as SUPPORTED. Peer R2 also covers C30-C31, C35-C36 which OpenEval addresses separately in R2.

Partial overlap on claims C30-C31, C35-C36. Both evaluations accept fertility testing data showing sterility. Both rate as SUPPORTED. Peer R2 also includes C37-C42 which OpenEval addresses separately in R4.

Agreement on claims C43-C47 regarding Xap5 cKO meiotic arrest. Both evaluations accept the histological and phenotypic data. Both rate as SUPPORTED. Peer R3 also covers C32-C34 which OpenEval addresses separately in R3.

Partial overlap on claims C32-C34 regarding embryonic lethality necessitating conditional knockout. Both evaluations accept this finding. Both rate as SUPPORTED. Peer R3 also includes C43-C47 which OpenEval addresses separately in R5.

Disagreement on claims C74-C75 regarding antagonistic regulation model. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on integration of multiple evidence lines. Peer review rates as UNCERTAIN, with Reviewer 2 explicitly challenging the antagonistic interpretation, noting different expression patterns and roles.
Agreement on claims C1, C7-C16, C76, C78-C84 (background/contextual claims). Both evaluations accept these as established knowledge supported by literature citations. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Agreement on claims C2, C17-C20 (background claims) and C77 (key finding). Both evaluations accept these, with C77 representing the novel contribution bridging evolutionary gaps. Both rate as SUPPORTED.
Agreement on claims C87-C88. Both evaluations accept the absence of proteins in mature sperm and the inference that they are not needed for maintenance. Both rate as SUPPORTED.

Agreement on claims C89-C90. Both evaluations recognize C89 as supported by literature and C90 as speculative. OpenEval explicitly rates as UNCERTAIN noting lack of experimental evidence. Peer review includes these in background claims without specific challenge.

OpenEval R10 addresses antagonistic regulation model (C74-C75) while Peer R8 addresses distinct phenotypes (C3-C4). These are related but distinct aspects - the phenotypic differences support but do not fully establish the antagonistic regulatory mechanism.
